name: Maezono Chinami
source:
A lively tomboy who studies perversion at St. Orgies’ Private Academy.

Good at sports, she considers herself to be somewhat of a rival for Chihiro when it comes to exercise and sex.
In addition to being the ace of the Gynaestics Club, Chinami manages and helps out at several other clubs as well.

A popular schoolgirl pervert who’s often fought over by her many admirers from the male sports clubs she’s involved in.

[From [url=http://www.mangagamer.com/detail.php?goods_type=0&product_code=1035]Mangagamer[/url]]
